title: The Life Enrichment Club 暢樂人生社
content_html: The Life Enrichment Club is a discussion group organized on June 22, 2009, by Sung-Peng Hsu and others who shared an interest in talks about life, death, and Eastern philosophies including Taoism, Buddhism, and Confucianism. The club brought together members to explore a wide range of intellectual topics including philosophies of life, chaos theory, genetics, DNA and human migrations, Mahayana Buddhism, astronomy, geology, and the arts. Sung-Peng Hsu served as coordinator from the club’s founding through the end of 2014. Five summary articles documenting club activities from 2009 through 2014 were produced and made available online.
